title: For PR 4: under a hold the chat mirror holds the page's profile beside the newly read medication and screening lists; and an own-save read that began before a whole re-read can write the page's earlier profile after that re-read
evidence: PR 2119 (US-34 AC10, US-15 AC10): under a hold the own-save read writes the saved profile and the mirror's own lists (useRecordApply signal, loadFromLocalStorage), never the lists on screen, so no unsaved list edit reaches the mirror; a read that stops being shown writes nothing further (useRecordReads reloadValues, moved). Root fix R13 PR 4 (2117) chose the source as it writes (useRecordReads ShownCopy). Left: ordering, no guard added; store reads are synchronous behind their promises (lib/roadmap-data.ts loadLatestMeasurements, loadLabValues), so values reads write in start order; unpinned.
